latest_release.body: # SwitchU v1.4.1 ## Stability, Compatibility & Quality-of-Life Improvements A polish and maintenance release following v1.4.0, with improvements to HOME stability, docked display scaling, controller support, SteamGridDB artwork, music playback, clock synchronization, localization, and more. --- ## 🗞 What's New & Fixed ### HOME Stability & Performance - **HOME Reliability & Art Cache** - Fixed HOME becoming unresponsive after a missed foreground transition. Improved folder and app reordering, reduced artwork cache rebuilds and browsing hitches, and optimized HOME artwork handling while Frame Tap is active. - **Music Resume** - Added **Resume music on return home** setting under Theme Shop → Sounds (enabled by default). When disabled tracks restart from the beginning on return to home. Resume improved by seeking off the UI thread in the background to keep HOME responsive. - **Leave Splash** - Suspended games always show the original HOME screenshot captured at launch instead of recapturing the screen on every resume. This keeps the return splash consistent with the original launch view, even if you navigate to another page or close a folder before resuming. ### Display & Artwork - **Live Dock / Undock Resizing** - Fixed the HOME menu retaining incorrect dimensions when docking or undocking while open. The managed display layer now correctly adjusts to handheld and TV resolutions, including display setting changes. - **SteamGridDB Hero Quality & Blur** - Added configurable hero backdrop quality (Off, Low, Medium, High) and adjustable blur (0–100%). Quality options control artwork resolution: - High: Native 1280px artwork - Medium: 640px artwork, upscaled 2× (default) - Low: 320px artwork, upscaled 4× - Off: Disables new hero downloads and backdrop rendering. Existing artwork remains on disk. - **High-Resolution Grid Posters** - Improved poster quality in 2×3 and legacy 1×2 grid layouts by using the dedicated high-resolution artwork pipeline, matching the sharper results already available in other layouts. ### Battery & Controller Status - **Battery Synchronization & Controller Indicators** - Fixed console battery status becoming stale after boot with a lightweight 30-second daemon PSM heartbeat, keeping HOME, Quick Settings, and the Batteries widget in sync. - Restored individual battery rings for Joy-Con L/R and Pro Controllers using an 8-second HID poll, including programmed controller body colors when reported by HID. - Improved docked controller detection, retaining last-known shell colors when handheld mode is unavailable and prioritizing Joy-Con rings over Pro Controllers when space is limited. - Refreshed widget graphics with more accurate Joy-Con proportions, tablet and rail assemblies, and a Pro Controller silhouette. Also removed the redundant charging bolt from the console battery ring. ### Controllers & Input - **Atmosphère Title Override Shortcut** - Fixed holding R + A being intercepted by HOME's button-chord handling. You can now launch the Atmosphère title override (full-RAM hbmenu) while holding R. Ultrahand's L + R + A shortcut still cancels as expected so it doesn't unintentionally trigger HOME sorting or Quick Settings. - **Sideways Single Joy-Con Support** - Fixed menu navigation when using a single Joy-Con held sideways. Button mappings and stick directions now correctly match the controller's orientation. - **GameCube & SystemExt Controller Support** - Added HOME navigation support for GameCube controllers and SystemE

detail.readme:
# SwitchU ### Wii U/3DS style custom home menu for Nintendo Switch


---

Screenshots  ·  Features  ·  Installation  ·  Themes & Icon Workshop  ·  SwitchU Manager  ·  How to build  ·  Known issues  ·  Contributing  ·  Credits  ·  License

## Screenshots
More screenshots Folders in Grid and Single-row views Hero and Posters displayed for Titles Quick Settings Side bar with built in Music player Alternate tiles sizes in grid view Themesshop with community submitted themes and icon packs
## ✨ Features | Area | What you get | |------|----------------| | **Home menu** | Wii U-inspired browsing, folders, posters / tile sizes, touch + trigger navigation | | **Theme Shop** | Browse, preview, and install community themes + icon packs (with tint modes) | | **Theme Studio** | Build and submit themes / icon packs from the web
[![Open Theme Studio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open_Theme_Studio-6364EE?style=for-the-badge)](https://polonx.github.io/SwitchU-Themes/) | **SteamGridDB** | Covers, heroes, posters - search missing artwork from Settings | | **Lock Screen** | Clock fonts, transitions, resume from suspended game, Lock from Power / Quick Settings | | **Music** | Quick Settings player, playlists, fullscreen player - put tracks in `sdmc:/switch/SwitchU/music/` | | **Languages** | Full HOME chrome for English + European packs, plus **Japanese / Simplified Chinese / Traditional Chinese / Korean** (shared system fonts for CJK glyphs) | | **Frame Tap** | Optional USB HOME capture with [Switch Frame Tap](https://github.com/TomasUribe/switch-frame-tap) (see below) | | **Battery Saver** | Dial back visuals to save power (also used when Frame Tap viewer needs headroom) | | **Manager** | Enable / disable SwitchU; in-app updates after you are on 1.4.0+ | > [!TIP] > Correct console time/date matters for SteamGridDB HTTPS. Use Settings timezone / NTP sync if artwork search fails. ## 💿 Installation 1. Download the latest **SwitchU** release ZIP from [Releases](https://github.com/PoloNX/SwitchU/releases/latest). 2. Extract it to the **root of your SD card**, merging the `atmosphere/` and `switch/` folders. 3. Eject the SD safely, then **reboot** into Atmosphere. ### Final layout ```text sdmc:/ ├── atmosphere/ ← sysmodule / exosphere pieces from the release └── switch/ └── SwitchU/ ├── SwitchU-Manager.nro ├── music/ ← optional local music library └── ... ``` ## 🎨 Themes & Icon Workshop Create themes, download packages, and submit icon packs here: [![Open Theme Studio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open_Theme_Studio-6364EE?style=for-the-badge)](https://polonx.github.io/SwitchU-Themes/) | On the site | On the Switch | |-------------|----------------| | Browse the live catalog and download `.zip` themes | Open **Theme Shop** from the HOME menu | | Live preview editor (colors, backgrounds, fonts, audio) | Apply themes / icon packs from Installed | | Submit themes or icon packs via GitHub sign-in | Theme Shop pulls the community catalog online | ### Manual theme install 1. Download a theme zip from Theme Studio (or Save draft as zip). 2. Unzip so you have a folder with `theme.json` inside. 3. Copy that folder to: ```text sdmc:/switch/SwitchU/themes// ← preferred for manual installs sdmc:/config/SwitchU/themes// ← Theme Shop install root (also still works) ``` 4. Open **Theme Shop → Installed** and apply it. > [!NOTE] > Theme Shop installs still write under `config/`. If the same theme id exists in both places, **config wins**. Icon packs install under `sdmc:/switch/SwitchU/icons/`. Catalog source repo: [PoloNX/SwitchU-Themes](https://github.com/PoloNX/SwitchU-Themes). ## 📹 Frame Tap (optional) Stream the SwitchU HOME menu to a PC over USB with **[Switch Frame Tap](https://github.com/TomasUribe/switch-frame-tap)** (v0.7.21.1 or later). 1. Install Frame Tap per its release notes. 2. In **Frame Tap Manager → Beta**, turn **Stream the HOME menu** ON (`home_menu = 1`). 3. Reboot, then connect the Viewer. SwitchU enables **Battery Saver** automatically while the Viewer needs headroom so both can share available memory. ## 🧰 SwitchU Manager `SwitchU-Manager.nro` (under `sdmc:/switch/SwitchU/`) lets you **enable or disable** SwitchU without deleting files. ## ⚠️ Known issues - Some settings are not implemented yet. - While sysmodules modules are now supported - some sysmodules or heavy stacks can still cause memory issues that result in failed boots, black screens or other issues like the clock not working. - To add more head room for sys-modules you can also try [Born to Honk's Atmosphere fork](https://github.com/borntohonk/Atmosphere/releases/tag/1.12.1+) (when setup correctly it can reclaim more memory on Firmware 20+ and doesn't need sys-patch which can be dropped from the stack) - Screenshots in this README may lag the newest UI; see [release notes](https://github.com/PoloNX/SwitchU/releases) for the latest visuals. ## 🤝 Contributing Bug reports and pull requests are welcome. - Open an [issue](https://github.com/PoloNX/SwitchU/issues) when something breaks. - Open a PR when you have a fix or improvement. - Theme / icon creators: use [Theme Studio](https://polonx.github.io/SwitchU-Themes/) to submit packages. ## 🔨 How to build ### Requirements - [devkitPro](https://devkitpro.org/wiki/Getting_Started) - [Xmake](https://xmake.io/#/) ### Clone ```bash git clone --recursive https://github.com/PoloNX/SwitchU cd SwitchU ``` ### Build (production daemon + external menu mode) ```bash xmake f -p cross --toolchain=devkita64 --homebrew=n --backend=deko3d xmake ``` ### Build (homebrew .nro mode) ```bash xmake f -p cross --toolchain=devkita64 --homebrew=y --backend=deko3d xmake ``` ### Clean ```bash xmake clean ``` Build outputs are generated under `build/cross/aarch64//`. ## 👾 Credits - [PoloNX](https://github.com/PoloNX) and everyone who ships SwitchU - [Xortroll](https://github.com/Xortroll) / [uLaunch](https://github.com/Xortroll/uLaunch) for inspiration and help early on - Theme and icon contributors via [SwitchU-Themes](https://github.com/PoloNX/SwitchU-Themes) - Community testers and PR authors across the release history ## 📄 License This project is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0. See [LICENSE](https://github.com/PoloNX/SwitchU/blob/master/LICENSE) for details.
